say:0:1721907001:1.text: After talking to the local animals, you've managed to gather quite a few clues about Miss Pearl.
say:0:1721907001:1.source_cn: 向动物们询问一圈后，你获知了不少与珍珠小姐有关的零散信息。
say:0:1721907001:1.male: After talking to the local animals, you've managed to gather quite a few clues about Miss Pearl.
say:0:1721907001:1.female: After talking to the local animals, you've managed to gather quite a few clues about Miss Pearl.

say:1:1721907002:1.text: The biggest revelation of all is that Miss Pearl is no ordinary fish—she's Savannah's fish queen, and clearly a lot more complicated than Aiden ever imagined.
say:1:1721907002:1.source_cn: 其中最为重磅的一条是，珍珠小姐竟然是赛凡纳的鱼王，一条...

say:2:1721907003:1.text: You jot everything down in your notes, trying to sort through it all before explaining it to Aiden...
say:2:1721907003:1.source_cn: 你将这些零散的信息在笔记上汇总了一下，以便向阿德里安解释……
say:2:1721907003:1.male: You jot everything down in your notes, trying to sort through it all before explaining it to Aiden...
say:2:1721907003:1.female: You jot everything down in your notes, trying to sort through it all before explaining it to Aiden...
